aria: Animated recap of the 76ers' 135 to 123 road win over the Nets: Joel Embiid's step-back 3-pointer with 52 seconds left after Brooklyn cut the lead to four, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Embiid's season-high 37 points, the top scorers, how the 76ers won, and the next game.
notes: Box score from the 76ers' 135–123 road win over the Brooklyn Nets at Barclays Center on Nov 16, 2026, from the Sports Illustrated box score, with game details from Field Level Media (via Yardbarker), the New York Daily News (via Yahoo Sports) and VAVEL. All 135 Philadelphia points and all 123 Brooklyn points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores (33–45–27–30 to 26–33–36–28) add up to both totals: 78–59 Philadelphia at the half (Daily News; VAVEL) and 105–95 after three (Field Level Media). Team totals (free throws 32 of 38 to 22 of 34, rebounds 47–38, field goals 45 of 88 to 44 of 88, steals 9–7, assists 25–26) are from the box score; the free throws match the Daily News. Philadelphia's biggest lead, 24, is from Field Level Media and the Daily News; Brooklyn's is left out. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Monday's games.

Joel Embiid's 37 was a season high, with 24 in the first half (Field Level Media; VAVEL). Jaylen Brown had 31 points and a season-best 13 rebounds (Field Level Media). LeBron James sat out on the second night of a back-to-back (Field Level Media; VAVEL). Brooklyn won the third quarter 36–27 and Michael Porter Jr. scored 12 of his 25 in it (Field Level Media; Daily News). Philadelphia plays at Orlando on Wednesday, Nov 18 (AP; tip time from SportBusy).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Joel Embiid's step-back 3-pointer with 52 seconds left (Field Level Media; the Daily News says he took a pass from Tyrese Maxey and buried a three with 52 seconds to play). Egor Demin's three with 1:14 left had cut Philadelphia's lead to 125–121 (Field Level Media), so the score is shown as margins. It is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from beyond the arc; the spot and the defender are not drawn to exact positions. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Philadelphia 76ers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Joel Embiid's listed 7-foot and 270 pounds with No. 21 (RealGM), arms scaled to the 7-foot-5.75 wingspan reported before the 2014 draft (theScore), in Philadelphia's road blue with his look from kit/looks.json. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
